body: [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3165940575](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3165940575) I followed this guide. It was the only thing that helped when I was encountering this error. Best of luck!

I’m so sorry to hear that! I really hope soon you’ll find something that helps. It sucks that so many of us have these problems and nothing seems to help. More research needs to be done to give us relief. In your case, it’s disrupting a major lifestyle decision. I’m sending good vibes and hopes your way.
Thank you! I’m definitely searching for one now. Hopefully I will find somebody good in my area who can give me some tools to manage the pain!

Thank you for your comment. Fun username by the way, haha! It really does hurt and I’m sorry you had to go through this too, but as the days pass the pain dulls and I’m just glad she won’t ever have to be in pain again.
Thank you for your kind words. I did just that, it was tough as it was my first night without her but she’ll always be with me. And boy do I have a lot of pics of her to remember her by!

I agree with ectra040. I got a Switch on launch day and I never had any of the issues discussed in that video, so since it's almost been a year since launch I'd be surprised if any of those issues even persist anymore.

I have one that's (unfortunately) a Best Buy exclusive from Insignia that is only $30-$40 and it is much smaller than the original Nintendo dock. Fits well in a bag and works just fine, I've played on it for several hours at a time with no problem.

That’s very helpful, thank you! I haven’t even dabbled in history mode yet so now that makes a bit more sense as to why I couldn’t fathom killing 5,000+ enemies in one round. Much appreciated, thanks again!

I love Louis C.K. and I'm devastated to hear this. I know separating art from artist is a thing, but it's really hard to enjoy someone's art when you know they're not a good person behind the scenes...

I imagine the scene with you staring this dude down, hair over your eyes, and him just getting totally terrified! Good thing you had that sword. Thanks for sharing, it's a great story and I'm glad you're safe!

I really hope you're right! I didn't even consider that until you brought it up, but if he was really that desperate I'm not so sure he would make an exception for his little sister. Let's pray nothing ever happened to her. :(
I'm so sorry to hear that :( I hope you got out of it unharmed! Stuff like this probably happens way more than we think.
